sv.title: Isak ger Liverpool ledningen i Champions League
sv.summary: Ett misstag kan bli dyrköpt om Alexander Isak spelar för motståndarlaget. Det fick belgiska Club Brügge erfara när svensken gav sitt Liverpool ledningen på bortaplan i Champions Leagues gruppspel.

en.title: Isak gives Liverpool the lead in the Champions League
en.summary: A mistake can prove costly if Alexander Isak plays for the opposing team. That is what Belgian club Club Brügge experienced when the Swede gave his Liverpool the lead away in the Champions League group stage.
